To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the spatial data quality of a 3D city model depends on the spatial data quality and the spatio- semantic coherence of the data sources.

the spatio- semantic coherences of 3D geodatasets are a key issue for the integration of 3D data and that the semantic data model of CityGML provides a good basis for the definition and the analysis of the spatio- semantics coherences.
The integration of 3D geospatial data with complex object semantics is a complex process that requires a high level of spatio-semantic coherency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an integrated approach for the automatic generation of 3D geospatial models from distributed data.
the development of methods for the integration of 3D geospatial data and the analysis and evaluation of 3D data structures with respect to their spatial and semantic coherence.
the question of how semantic data can be used to reduce the ambigu-ity of spatial integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single method that is applicable to all data sources.
a high degree of semantic coherence is a necessary but not a sufficient condition for the successful geometric integration of 3D models.
the spatial data quality is of great importance for 3D integration and that the spatial data model is of high relevance for the quality of 3D data integration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the spatial and semantic data quality of 3D geospatial data is a key issue for the integration process and that a spatio-semantic analysis of data quality can be an essential part of an integrated data management system.
the spatial data quality is an essential precondition for a successful integration process.

the spatial and semantic data quality of 3D geodatabases are closely related. The more complex the spatial and semantic structure of a 3D geobasis, the more challenging the data integration process becomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
semantic information can help to improve the quality and consistency of 3D geospatial data.
spatial data quality and spatio-semantic coherences are important factors for the development of 3D data integration methods.
semantic data models should be designed with a clear focus on spatial data integration in mind, and that the semantic structure should be aligned with the spatial structure of the data.
